intent.statement: Add an AI Settings chunking context mode option that controls paragraph caps for AI chunking prompts: Balanced uses current 64/96/128 caps, Wide scene context uses larger paragraph windows, and Maximum context uses token budget only without a paragraph cap.

examples: A settings payload without a chunking context mode loads as Balanced; selecting Wide scene context or Maximum context survives AI Settings save and reload.
spec_items.statement: AI Settings shall expose and persist a default chunking context mode with exactly three options: Balanced, Wide scene context, and Maximum context, defaulting missing or invalid settings to Balanced.

examples: For scene strategy with enough token budget, Balanced caps a request window at 128 paragraphs, Wide scene context caps it at 256 paragraphs, and Maximum context can include more than 256 paragraphs until the text token budget is reached.
spec_items.statement: AI-assisted chunking shall build prompt windows from the selected chunking context mode: Balanced uses the current 64, 96, and 128 paragraph caps for paragraph, meaning, and scene strategies; Wide scene context uses 128, 192, and 256 paragraph caps; Maximum context uses only the token budget with no paragraph cap.
spec_items.threshold: Balanced paragraph caps remain backward-compatible at 64/96/128; Wide scene context caps are 128/192/256; Maximum context paragraph cap is disabled.
